h1: The 7 Best Eufy Robot Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Eufy Robot Vacuums 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven Eufy robot vacuums from the E25 flagship to the 11S MAX, compared on suction, mopping, docks and low-furniture clearance.
summary: The eufy E25 is our best overall, with 20,000 Pa suction and a self-washing roller mop dock. The E28 Matic adds a detachable carpet-cleaning tool, and the X10 Pro Omni is the choice for pet homes with carpet and hardwood. For no-mop buyers, the C10 is slim and self-emptying, while the 11S MAX is the simplest and cheapest.
intro: Eufy sells robots at two very different levels of effort: ones that wash their own mops and ones that just vacuum. The mistake is buying a mop-capable model when your floors are mostly carpet, or buying a vacuum-only unit and wishing it mopped. Decide on the mop first, then choose the dock.

We reviewed seven Eufy models on paper, ranking them on stated suction, mop design, dock automation, profile height and price tier. The ranking leans on listings and owner reports, so treat the dock claims as manufacturer descriptions.

products.name: eufy E25 Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo, 20,000 Pa, HydroJet Roller Mop
products.verdict: Top suction with a HydroJet roller mop and self-washing dock.
products.description:
The eufy E25 lists 20,000 Pa suction, a HydroJet roller mop and a self-washing dock, as a vacuum and mop combo.

It ranks first because it combines the top suction tier with a roller mop that washes itself at the dock. Next to the E28 below, you trade the detachable carpet tool for a simpler, mop-first design.

Buy it for a household that wants strong suction and real mopping. The caveat is the $500+ price.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting top suction and real roller mopping.

products.name: eufy E28 Matic Robot Vacuum and Mop, 20,000 Pa, Portable Carpet Cleaning
products.verdict: A robot vacuum plus a detachable tool for stairs and upholstery.
products.description:
The E28 Matic also lists 20,000 Pa suction, with a Matic mop system, a self-maintaining dock and portable carpet cleaning.

It ranks second because the portable cleaner covers stairs and upholstery, which the E25 cannot reach. The mop system is different from the E25's HydroJet roller.

Choose it if you want a spot-cleaning tool along with the robot. The caveat is the $500+ price.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want to clean stairs and upholstery too.

products.name: eufy X10 Pro Omni Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo, Dual Mops with 12mm Auto-Lift
products.verdict: Dual rotating mops that lift 12mm over carpet, with an Omni dock.
products.description:
The X10 Pro Omni has dual rotating mops with a 12mm auto-lift and an Omni all-in-one dock, as a vacuum and mop combo.

It ranks third because the listing gives no suction figure, while the E25 and E28 state 20,000 Pa. Its strength is the auto-lift, which handles carpet-to-hardwood transitions.

Buy it if you have pets and mixed floors. The caveat is that it sits in the $200-500 bracket without a stated suction.
products.idealFor: Pet owners with carpet and hardwood.
products.skipIf: You want a published suction number.

products.name: eufy C28 Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo, 15,000 Pa, HydroJet Roller Mop
products.verdict: Roller-mop washing at 15,000 Pa without the flagship price.
products.description:
The eufy C28 lists 15,000 Pa suction, a HydroJet roller mop and a self-washing dock, as a combo.

It ranks fourth because it steps down from the E25's 20,000 Pa but keeps the roller mop and self-washing dock. It lists in the $200-500 bracket.

Choose it for roller-mop washing on a lower budget. The caveat is the lower suction.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting roller mopping on a budget.

products.name: eufy Omni C20 Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo for Hardwood and Carpet
products.verdict: Omni dock convenience with a hardwood and carpet mode.
products.description:
The Omni C20 has an Omni all-in-one dock, a self-emptying design and a hardwood and carpet mode, as a vacuum and mop combo.

It ranks fifth because the listing gives no suction number, and it targets convenience rather than power. It lists in the $200-500 bracket.

Buy it for a mixed-flooring home wanting Omni-tier emptying. The caveat is the missing suction spec.

products.name: eufy C10 Robot Vacuum Self Emptying, 8 Weeks Hands Free, 2.85-Inch Slim
products.verdict: A 2.85 inch slim vacuum that self-empties for up to 8 weeks.
products.description:
The eufy C10 is a vacuum-only robot with a 2.85 inch slim profile and a self-emptying dock rated for 8 weeks hands free.

It ranks sixth because it has no mop, which limits it against the combos above. It does fit under low furniture and cuts dock chores to a minimum.

Choose it if you have decided you do not need mopping. The caveat is that it lists in the $200-500 bracket with no mop.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a slim vacuum-only unit.

products.name: eufy 11S MAX Robot Vacuum Cleaner, Super Thin, Quiet
products.verdict: The lowest price and simplest upkeep, with a super-slim quiet body.
products.description:
The eufy 11S MAX is a vacuum-only robot with a super-slim profile and quiet operation. It has no dock to maintain.

It ranks last because it has no mop and no self-emptying, so you empty the bin by hand. It is also the cheapest here, in the $100-200 bracket.

Buy it as a first robot vacuum or on a tight budget. The caveat is the manual upkeep and lack of mopping.

whatMatters.detail: Roller mops press and wash a continuous pad, and rotating mops spin two pads. A roller is the more thorough design on paper. Look for the mop name in the title.
Docks may empty dust, wash mops or both. Self-washing saves you rinsing pads. Check for 'self-washing', 'self-emptying' or 'Omni' on the listing.
Pa is a suction pressure claim, and 15,000 to 20,000 Pa sits at the high end. It matters most on carpet. Remember it is a manufacturer figure.
A 2.85 inch body fits under many sofas and beds. Measure your lowest furniture clearance. Check the height in the listing bullets.
Auto-lift raises mops over carpet to avoid wetting it. The X10 Pro lists 12mm. Check the figure on your listing.

faq.q: Which Eufy is best for pets?
faq.a: The X10 Pro Omni is aimed at pet homes with carpet and hardwood. Its 12mm auto-lift handles transitions.
They buy a mop model for carpeted homes. Mopping adds little there, so a vacuum-only unit may suit.

faq.q: Is the E25 worth it over the C28?
faq.a: If you want 20,000 Pa over 15,000 Pa, yes. Both have the HydroJet roller mop and self-washing dock.

faq.q: How do I set up the dock?
faq.a: Place it against a wall with clear space. Follow the app to map your home.

faq.q: How do I maintain the dock?
faq.a: Empty or replace the dust bag and clean the mop pad. The C10 lists 8 weeks between emptying.
No. It is vacuum-only with no dock to maintain.

finalTake: The eufy E25 is the best Eufy overall for suction and a self-washing dock. The E28 Matic adds a portable carpet tool, and the X10 Pro Omni suits pet homes. If you do not need mopping, the C10 and 11S MAX are the simpler picks.
